title: Adaptive Advantage of the Emerging Seasonal Influenza A (H3N2) Subclade K: Enhanced Receptor Binding Capacity and Immune Escape Potential
abstract: Emerging influenza variants continue to drive waves of flu globally.Notably, the influenza A (H3N2) subclade K (J.2.4.1) is currently the dominant strain during the 2025-2026 Northern Hemisphere influenza season, spreading rapidly across Asia, Europe, and North America [ 1 ].These variants exhibit multiple mutations in the hemagglutinin (HA) protein, including key substitutions in regions of antigenic sites A, B, and D, as well as the receptor binding site (RBS) (Figure 1A ).Notably, glycosylation changes at positions 135 (loss) and 144 (gain) may contribute to its enhanced adaptability.The rapid spread of subclade K, along with early reports of flu outbreaks in countries such as Japan, the United Kingdom (UK) and the United States (USA), has prompted public health agencies to prioritize surveillance and vaccine updates [ 2,3 ].However, the biological characteristics of the newly emerging subclade K remain unclear.In this study, we retrieved all available HA sequences of influenza A (H3N2) virus belonging to clade J (2a.3a.1) from the Global Initiative on Sharing All Influenza Data (GISAID) platform.These sequences were geographically sourced from Asia, Europe, and North America, spanning the period from June 6, 2020 to January 16, 2026.A total of 62,080 HA sequences were obtained, including 11,014 sequences from the 2025-2026 influenza season.Among these, 9,795 (88.93%) were classified as subclade K.We randomly selected 5 viral sequences from each subclade (J, J.1, J.2, J.2.2, J.2.4, K) in each region of the three areas, totaling 90 viral sequences for the study of biological characteristics.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Emerging influenza variants continue to drive waves of flu globally. Notably, the influenza A (H3N2) subclade K (J.2.4.1) is currently the dominant strain during the 2025-2026 Northern Hemisphere influenza season, spreading rapidly across Asia, Europe, and North America [A1].
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study retrieved all available HA sequences of influenza A (H3N2) virus belonging to clade J (2a.3a.1) from the GISAID platform, geographically sourced from Asia, Europe, and North America, spanning the period from June 6, 2020 to January 16, 2026 [A1]. A total of 62,080 HA sequences were obtained, including 11,014 sequences from the 2025-2026 influenza season. Among these, 9,795 (88.93%) were classified as subclade K.
analysis.methods: The study randomly selected 5 viral sequences from each subclade (J, J.1, J.2, J.2.2, J.2.4, K) in each region of the three areas, totaling 90 viral sequences for the study of biological characteristics [A1].
analysis.main_results: The study identified multiple mutations in the hemagglutinin (HA) protein of the subclade K variants, including key substitutions in regions of antigenic sites A, B, and D, as well as the receptor binding site (RBS) [A1].
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these mutations as potentially contributing to the enhanced adaptability of subclade K, which may explain its rapid spread and immune escape potential [A1].
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the need for updated surveillance and vaccine strategies to address the evolving characteristics of subclade K, which is currently the dominant strain in the 2025-2026 influenza season [A1].
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on sequence data from the GISAID platform, which may not fully represent all circulating strains. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational nature of the analysis [A1].

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the biological characteristics of the emerging influenza A (H3N2) subclade K, which is currently the dominant strain during the 2025-2026 Northern Hemisphere influenza season. The research highlights the multiple mutations in the hemagglutinin (HA) protein of subclade K variants, particularly in antigenic sites A, B, and D, as well as the receptor binding site (RBS). These mutations may contribute to the subclade's enhanced adaptability and immune escape potential, which could explain its rapid spread across Asia, Europe, and North America. The study retrieved HA sequences from GISAID, spanning from June 2020 to January 2026, and randomly selected 90 sequences for analysis. The findings suggest the need for updated surveillance and vaccine strategies to address the evolving nature of subclade K. However, the study is limited by its reliance on sequence data and the observational nature of the analysis, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 新出现的流感变种继续在全球范围内引发流感浪潮。值得注意的是,甲型流感 (H3N2) K 亚支 (J.2.4.1) 目前是 2025-2026 年北半球流感季节的主导毒株,在亚洲、欧洲和北美迅速传播 [A1]。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究从GISAID平台检索了属于J分支(2a.3a.1)的甲型流感(H3N2)病毒的所有可用HA序列,其地理来源来自亚洲、欧洲和北美,时间跨度为2020年6月6日至2026年1月16日[A1]。总共获得了 62,080 个 HA 序列,其中包括 2025-2026 年流感季节的 11,014 个序列。其中,9,795(88.93%)被归类为K亚支。
elements_zh.methods: 研究随机从三个地区的每个分支(J、J.1、J.2、J.2.2、J.2.4、K)中各选取5条病毒序列,共计90条病毒序列用于生物学特征研究[A1]。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究在分支K变异株的血凝素(HA)蛋白中识别出多个突变,包括抗原位点A、B、D区域及受体结合位点(RBS)的关键替换[A1]。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些突变解释为可能有助于分支K增强适应性,这或许能解释其快速传播和免疫逃逸潜力[A1]。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了更新疫苗株和抗病毒药物策略的必要性,以应对分支K的进化特征,该分支目前是2025-2026流感季的优势株[A1]。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其依赖 GISAID 平台的序列数据而受到限制,该平台可能无法完全代表所有流行菌株。由于分析的观察性质,证据的强度中等[A1]。

abstract_zh: 新兴流感变异株继续在全球引发流感流行。值得注意的是,甲型H3N2流感病毒分支K(J.2.4.1)目前是2025-2026年北半球流感季的优势株,正在亚洲、欧洲和北美快速传播[1]。这些变异株在血凝素(HA)蛋白中表现出多个突变,包括抗原位点A、B、D区域及受体结合位点(RBS)的关键替换(图1A)。值得注意的是,第135位(丧失)和第144位(获得)的糖基化改变可能有助于其增强适应性。分支K的快速传播,以及日本、英国(UK)和美国(USA)等国早期报告的流感病例,已促使公共卫生机构优先更新疫苗株和抗病毒药物策略[2,3]。然而,新兴分支K的生物学特征仍不清楚。本研究从全球共享流感数据倡议(GISAID)平台检索了属于分支J(2a.3a.1)的甲型H3N2流感病毒所有可用HA序列。这些序列在地理上源自亚洲、欧洲和北美,时间跨度为2020年6月6日至2026年1月16日。共获得62,080条HA序列,其中包含2025-2026流感季的11,014条序列。在这些序列中,9,795条(88.93%)被归类为分支K。研究随机从三个地区的每个分支(J、J.1、J.2、J.2.2、J.2.4、K)中各选取5条病毒序列,共计90条病毒序列用于生物学特征研究。

title: Morbidity and mortality burden of seasonal influenza in sub-Saharan Africa: a systematic review and meta-analysis protocol
abstract: Seasonal influenza poses a significant global health burden, responsible for substantial morbidity and mortality annually, particularly among high-risk populations such as the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and individuals with chronic illnesses. While the burden of influenza is well-documented in high-income countries, limited data exist for sub-Saharan African (SSA) countries, where fragile healthcare systems and underreporting obscure the true impact. Influenza exacerbates prevalent health conditions such as HIV, malaria, and malnutrition, further increasing its toll. The meta-analysis outlined in this protocol aims to systematically assess the morbidity and mortality burden of seasonal influenza in SSA countries, providing policymakers with critical insights to strengthen surveillance, prioritize at-risk populations, and inform vaccination strategies. This is a protocol for a planned systematic review and meta-analysis. This research will follow the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines, incorporating observational studies and surveillance reports published between August 2010 and December 2026. We will search major health databases, including MEDLINE (via PubMed), Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library, as well as regional databases (African Index Medicus and the WHO Global Index Medicus) and grey literature sources (medRxiv and national health reports). Studies reporting laboratory-confirmed seasonal influenza cases from SSA countries will be included. A standardized form will be used for data extraction, capturing morbidity (prevalence, incidence, and hospitalization rates) and mortality (case-fatality rates and excess mortality rates) indicators. Pooled data will be analyzed using meta-analytic techniques, applying random-effects models to account for heterogeneity. Sensitivity analyses will address variations in case definitions, methodologies, and study quality across studies. Publication and language bias will be mitigated by including grey literature and applying no language restrictions. The completed review is expected to provide updated, pooled estimates of seasonal influenza-associated morbidity and mortality across SSA countries, stratified by age group, geographic subregion, and presence of comorbidities. These findings will support evidence-based policy decisions, including the strengthening of influenza surveillance systems and the prioritization of vaccination programs for high-risk populations in SSA countries. As this study involves secondary data from published literature, ethical approval is not required. Results will be disseminated via a peer-reviewed publication, conference presentations, and stakeholder meetings. Tailored reports will be shared with policymakers in SSA countries to translate findings into public health strategies, particularly to enhance surveillance and implement targeted vaccination programs. PROSPERO CRD42024617707

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 季节性流感对全球健康构成重大负担,每年导致大量发病率和死亡率,尤其是在高风险人群中,如老年人、婴幼儿、孕妇和患有慢性疾病的个体。本协议中概述的荟萃分析旨在系统评估季节性流感在SSA国家的发病率和死亡率负担,为政策制定者提供关键见解,以加强监测、优先考虑高风险人群,并制定疫苗接种策略。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本研究将遵循系统综述和荟萃分析的首选报告项目(PRISMA)2020指南,纳入2010年8月至2026年12月期间发表的观察性研究和监测报告。我们将搜索主要的健康数据库,包括MEDLINE(通过PubMed)、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science和Cochrane图书馆,以及区域数据库(非洲医学索引和世界卫生组织全球医学索引)和灰色文献来源(medRxiv和国家健康报告)。将纳入来自SSA国家的实验室确诊季节性流感病例的研究。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 完成的综述预计将在SSA国家提供更新的、汇总的季节性流感相关发病率和死亡率估计,按年龄组、地理次区域和合并症的存在情况进行分层。流感会加重普遍存在的健康状况,如HIV、疟疾和营养不良,进一步增加其危害。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 提供的证据未报告关于SSA国家季节性流感负担的具体汇总估计或稳定结论。综述协议概述了方法,但未包含实质性结果或解释。证据未详细讨论异质性或冲突发现。提供的证据未涉及关于SSA国家季节性流感负担的未解决机制或具体证据缺口。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 这些发现将支持基于证据的政策决策,包括加强流感监测系统和优先考虑SSA国家高风险人群的疫苗接种项目。将为SSA国家的政策制定者提供定制报告,将研究结果转化为公共卫生策略,特别是增强监测并实施针对性的疫苗接种项目。

title: Deciphering influenza B virus-derived peptides and their presentation by HLA class I molecules.
abstract: Despite influenza vaccines being widely available, influenza still causes significant morbidity and mortality annually. Vaccines typically induce humoral-mediated protection against rapidly mutating surface glycoproteins, necessitating that they be updated and administered each year. In contrast, CD8+ T cells, which can control and clear viral infections, can recognise more conserved viral epitopes. Therefore, there is considerable interest in understanding CD8+ T cell responses to influenza virus for the development of future vaccines and therapeutics. Although Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUAV) and Betainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUBV) co-circulate in humans and both contribute to seasonal epidemics, there is limited data regarding CD8+ T cell responses to FLUBV. This knowledge gap spans both immunological and molecular insights. In the present review, we summarise the current knowledge of FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at both cellular and molecular levels, in comparison with FLUAV. Collectively, this highlights the limited data available on FLUBV, despite its significant role in human influenza infections.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines human seasonal influenza B virus (FLUBV) with a focus on CD8+ T cell responses to conserved epitopes, contrasting with influenza A virus (FLUAV) and addressing the central question of how these responses could inform future vaccines and therapeutics.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review synthesizes current knowledge on FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at cellular and molecular levels, explicitly comparing FLUBV to FLUAV, and highlights the limited data available on FLUBV despite its role in human influenza infections.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that CD8+ T cells recognize more conserved viral epitopes than humoral responses, offering potential for broader protection, but notes that FLUBV-specific CD8+ T cell epitope data remain sparse compared to FLUAV.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies a significant knowledge gap regarding FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes, spanning both immunological and molecular insights, and emphasizes the lack of comparative data between FLUBV and FLUAV in this context.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review prioritizes research to characterize FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes and their presentation by HLA class I molecules, aiming to guide the development of vaccines and therapeutics that leverage conserved T cell responses.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses human seasonal influenza B virus (FLUBV) with a focus on CD8+ T cell responses to conserved epitopes, contrasting with influenza A virus (FLUAV). It highlights that current vaccines, which induce humoral responses against rapidly mutating surface glycoproteins, require annual updates, whereas CD8+ T cells target more conserved epitopes, offering potential for broader protection. The review synthesizes existing knowledge on FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at cellular and molecular levels, explicitly comparing FLUBV to FLUAV. It concludes that CD8+ T cell responses to FLUBV are understudied, with limited data available despite FLUBV's significant role in human influenza infections. The review identifies a critical gap in understanding FLUBV-specific CD8+ T cell epitopes and their HLA class I presentation, emphasizing the need for further research to inform the development of vaccines and therapeutics leveraging conserved T cell responses.

source_body_en: Despite influenza vaccines being widely available, influenza still causes significant morbidity and mortality annually. Vaccines typically induce humoral-mediated protection against rapidly mutating surface glycoproteins, necessitating that they be updated and administered each year. In contrast, CD8+ T cells, which can control and clear viral infections, can recognise more conserved viral epitopes. Therefore, there is considerable interest in understanding CD8+ T cell responses to influenza virus for the development of future vaccines and therapeutics. Although Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUAV) and Betainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUBV) co-circulate in humans and both contribute to seasonal epidemics, there is limited data regarding CD8+ T cell responses to FLUBV. This knowledge gap spans both immunological and molecular insights. In the present review, we summarise the current knowledge of FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at both cellular and molecular levels, in comparison with FLUAV. Collectively, this highlights the limited data available on FLUBV, despite its significant role in human influenza infections.

title: Phylogeographic Dynamics and Spatial Connectivity of Influenza A(H3N2) in Brazil
abstract: Influenza A(H3N2) viruses show continuous antigenic and genetic evolution, requiring sustained molecular surveillance to understand their circulation and geographic spread. This study investigated the epidemiological, evolutionary, and phylogeographic dynamics of A(H3N2) viruses circulating in Brazil between 2011 and 2019. Epidemiological surveillance data from Northern and Northeastern Brazil were analyzed together with hemagglutinin (HA) gene sequences generated in this study and sequences retrieved from GISAID EpiFlu database. Phylogenetic and Bayesian phylogeographic analyses were performed to characterize genetic diversity and viral dispersal. Among 23,278 respiratory samples, 1,003 (4.31%) were positive for A(H3N2), with seasonal peaks occurring mainly between epidemiological weeks 13 and 16. Phylogenetic analyses revealed successive lineage replacement, with predominance of 3C.2a-derived clades after 2015. Phylogeographic reconstruction identified multiple international introductions into Brazil and extensive viral movement among Brazilian regions, with Southeastern Brazil acting as the main hub of national connectivity. Northern and Northeastern Brazil participated predominantly as recipient regions while also contributing to onward viral dissemination. These findings highlight the interconnected nature of A(H3N2) circulation in Brazil and reinforce the importance of integrating genomic and epidemiological surveillance to understand influenza dynamics.
authors: Edna Maria Acunã de Sousa Fillizola
Marilda Agudo Mendonça Teixeira de Siqueira

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了巴西北部与东北部的流行病学监测数据,并结合本研究产生的血凝素(HA)基因序列及从GISAID EpiFlu数据库检索的序列。研究聚焦于2011年至2019年间收集的呼吸道样本。

elements_zh.main_results: 在23,278份呼吸道样本中,1,003份(4.31%)甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09检测阳性,季节性高峰主要出现在流行病学周第13至16周。系统发育分析显示病毒谱系持续替换,2015年后3C.2a衍生分支占主导地位。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调整合基因组与流行病学监测以更好地理解流感动态的重要性,可为制定有针对性的公共卫生干预措施及提升未来疫情应对能力提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖流行病学监测数据与基因组序列,可能在捕捉完整病毒扩散模式方面存在局限性。然而,多源数据的整合支持研究结论具有中等可信度。

Phylogenetic analyses revealed successive lineage replacement, with predominance of 3C.2a-derived clades after 2015. Phylogeographic reconstruction identified multiple international introductions into Brazil and extensive viral movement among Brazilian regions, with Southeastern Brazil acting as the main hub of national connectivity. Northern and Northeastern Brazil participated predominantly as recipient regions while also contributing to onward viral dissemination. These findings highlight the interconnected nature of A(H3N2) circulation in Brazil and reinforce the importance of integrating genomic and epidemiological surveillance to understand influenza dynamics.

title: Within-host antigenic selection of influenza A virus dominates over stochasticity but is limited by fitness tradeoffs and timing of the immune response
abstract: ABSTRACT Despite antigenic evolution at the global scale, positive selection of influenza virus antigenic variants is not readily observed within hosts. Here, we tested the extent to which fitness tradeoffs, the timing of immune pressure, and stochastic effects impede antigenic selection within pre-immune hosts. We used genetically barcoded influenza A/Texas/50/2012 (H3N2) viruses (Tx/12) in a guinea pig model to probe these dynamics. Positive selection of an antigenic variant was reliant on a high strength of immune pressure acting early in infection. However, when fitness tradeoffs of the antigenic change were lessened, a lower strength and later introduction of immune pressure favored the antigenic variant. In all conditions, barcode dynamics revealed moderate stochastic effects. Our results suggest that stochastic evolution does not impede selection during acute influenza virus infection. The rarity of antigenic escape may instead stem from low mutational supply, fitness tradeoffs, and the intrinsic delay between infection and antibody recall.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of antigenic selection in influenza virus evolution within hosts, addressing the question of why antigenic variants are not commonly observed despite global antigenic evolution.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a guinea pig model with genetically barcoded influenza A/Texas/50/2012 (H3N2) viruses to test how fitness tradeoffs, immune timing, and stochastic effects influence antigenic selection during acute infection.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed genetically barcoded influenza A/Texas/50/2012 (H3N2) viruses in a guinea pig model to examine the dynamics of antigenic selection, including the impact of immune pressure timing and fitness tradeoffs.
analysis.main_results: Barcode dynamics showed moderate stochastic effects across all conditions, but positive selection of an antigenic variant was observed only when immune pressure was strong and early in infection.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that stochastic evolution does not prevent antigenic selection during acute influenza virus infection, and that immune pressure timing and fitness tradeoffs are key factors in determining the success of antigenic variants.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the mechanisms of antigenic escape within hosts, which could inform strategies for vaccine design and understanding viral evolution in seasonal influenza outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a guinea pig model and does not account for human-specific factors, but the evidence is strong due to the use of barcoded viruses and controlled experimental conditions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the dynamics of antigenic selection in influenza A virus within hosts, focusing on the interplay between immune pressure timing, fitness tradeoffs, and stochastic effects. Using a guinea pig model with genetically barcoded H3N2 viruses, the researchers found that positive selection of antigenic variants is possible when immune pressure is strong and early in infection. However, when fitness tradeoffs are reduced, lower immune pressure and later introduction of immune pressure can also favor antigenic variants. Moderate stochastic effects were observed across all conditions, but they did not impede selection. The study highlights the importance of immune timing and fitness tradeoffs in antigenic evolution, offering insights into vaccine design and understanding viral adaptation in seasonal influenza. The findings are limited to a guinea pig model and may not fully reflect human infection dynamics, but the experimental approach provides strong evidence for the role of these factors in antigenic selection.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of antigenic selection in influenza virus evolution within hosts, addressing the question of why antigenic variants are not commonly observed despite global antigenic evolution.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study used a guinea pig model with genetically barcoded influenza A/Texas/50/2012 (H3N2) viruses to test how fitness tradeoffs, immune timing, and stochastic effects influence antigenic selection during acute infection.
analysis_en.methods: The researchers employed genetically barcoded influenza A/Texas/50/2012 (H3N2) viruses in a guinea pig model to examine the dynamics of antigenic selection, including the impact of immune pressure timing and fitness tradeoffs.
analysis_en.main_results: Barcode dynamics showed moderate stochastic effects across all conditions, but positive selection of an antigenic variant was observed only when immune pressure was strong and early in infection.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that stochastic evolution does not prevent antigenic selection during acute influenza virus infection, and that immune pressure timing and fitness tradeoffs are key factors in determining the success of antigenic variants.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the mechanisms of antigenic escape within hosts, which could inform strategies for vaccine design and understanding viral evolution in seasonal influenza outbreaks.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a guinea pig model and does not account for human-specific factors, but the evidence is strong due to the use of barcoded viruses and controlled experimental conditions.

title_zh: 甲型流感病毒的 宿主 内抗原选择在随机性上占主导地位,但受到 免疫应答 的适应性权衡和时间安排的限制
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Despite antigenic evolution at the global scale, positive selection of influenza virus antigenic variants is not readily observed within hosts. Here, we tested the extent to which fitness tradeoffs, the timing of immune pressure, and stochastic effects impede antigenic selection within pre-immune hosts. We used genetically barcoded influenza A/Texas/50/2012 (H3N2) viruses (Tx/12) in a guinea pig model to probe these dynamics. Positive selection of an antigenic variant was reliant on a high strength of immune pressure acting early in infection. However, when fitness tradeoffs of the antigenic change were lessened, a lower strength and later introduction of immune pressure favored the antigenic variant. In all conditions, barcode dynamics revealed moderate stochastic effects. Our results suggest that stochastic evolution does not impede selection during acute influenza virus infection. The rarity of antigenic escape may instead stem from low mutational supply, fitness tradeoffs, and the intrinsic delay between infection and antibody recall.

title: Conserved influenza A epitope candidate regions and a benchmark of ESM-2 sequence features
abstract: Influenza A virus antigenic drift forces annual vaccine reformulation, motivating the search for conserved epitope candidates that could support broadly protective vaccines. We systematically screened influenza A virus sequences (H1N1, H3N2, H5N1; nine viral proteins) to define 98 conserved candidate regions, 38 of which were identical across the H1N1, H3N2, and H5N1 consensus sequences, all in the polymerase complex and nucleoprotein (PB2, PB1, PA, NP), whereas the ten surface-glycoprotein (HA/NA) candidates were subtype-specific. We then benchmarked two protein-language-model (ESM-2) features against alignment conservation. Group-masked log-probability correlated moderately with MSA conservation (Spearman rho = 0.25 to 0.39 for HA) but provided no incremental value for T-cell epitope discrimination (change in AUROC +0.004, p = 0.46); attention-derived contact-density was not a valid solvent-accessibility proxy. A curated antibody-epitope benchmark (22 clusters, 5 neutralization-supported) was underpowered for a high-confidence B-cell test. We document data-quality and reproducibility pitfalls (length heterogeneity, coordinate mapping, and pseudoreplication) and release the auditable benchmark. These results provide an auditable candidate resource and show that, in the evaluated benchmarks, ESM-2 sequence scores did not improve epitope prioritization beyond alignment-derived conservation.

We systematically screened influenza A virus sequences (H1N1, H3N2, H5N1; nine viral proteins) to define 98 conserved candidate regions, 38 of which were identical across the H1N1, H3N2, and H5N1 consensus sequences — all in the polymerase complex and nucleoprotein (PB2, PB1, PA, NP) — whereas the ten surface-glycoprotein (HA/NA) candidates were subtype-specific. We then benchmarked two protein-language-model (ESM-2) features against alignment conservation. Group-masked log-probability correlated moderately with MSA conservation (Spearman ρ = 0.25–0.39 for HA) but provided no incremental value for T-cell epitope discrimination (ΔAUROC +0.004, p = 0.46); attention-derived contact-density was not a valid solvent-accessibility proxy. A curated antibody-epitope benchmark (22 clusters, 5 neutralization-supported) was underpowered for a high-confidence B-cell test. We document data-quality and reproducibility pitfalls (length heterogeneity, coordinate mapping, and pseudoreplication) and release the auditable benchmark. These results provide an auditable candidate resource and show that, in the evaluated benchmarks, ESM-2 sequence scores did not improve epitope prioritization beyond alignment-derived conservation.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to identify conserved epitope candidates in influenza A virus to support the development of broadly protective vaccines. The researchers systematically analyzed sequences from H1N1, H3N2, and H5N1 subtypes across nine viral proteins, identifying 98 conserved regions. They found that ESM-2 features showed moderate correlation with sequence conservation but did not enhance epitope prioritization. The study also highlighted limitations in data quality and reproducibility. These findings offer an auditable resource for epitope candidates but suggest that current sequence-based models may not surpass traditional alignment methods in identifying conserved regions. The results have implications for vaccine design and epitope research but emphasize the need for improved benchmarks and data standards.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们系统地筛选了甲型流感病毒序列(H1N1、H3N2、H5N1;九种病毒蛋白),以确定 98 个保守候选区域,其中 38 个在 H1N1、H3N2 和 H5N1 共有序列中是相同的,全部位于聚合酶复合物和核蛋白(PB2、PB1、PA、NP)中,而 10 个表面糖蛋白(HA/NA)候选区域是亚型特异性的。
elements_zh.methods: 随后,我们将两种蛋白质语言模型(ESM-2)特征与多序列比对保守性进行基准测试。
elements_zh.main_results: 组掩码对数似然概率与血凝素(HA)的多序列比对保守性呈中等相关性(Spearman rho值为0.25至0.39),但未为T细胞表位鉴别提供增量价值(AUROC变化+0.004,p=0.46);注意力衍生的接触密度并非有效的溶剂可及性代理。

abstract_zh: 甲型流感病毒 抗原漂移 迫使每年重新配制 疫苗,从而激发了对可支持广泛保护性 疫苗 的保守表位候选者的搜索。我们系统地筛选了甲型流感病毒序列(H1N1、H3N2、H5N1;九种病毒蛋白),以确定 98 个保守候选区域,其中 38 个在 H1N1、H3N2 和 H5N1 共有序列中是相同的,全部位于聚合酶复合物和核蛋白(PB2、PB1、PA、NP)中,而 10 个表面糖蛋白(HA/NA)候选区域是亚型特异性的。然后,我们对两个蛋白质语言模型 (ESM-2) 特征与对齐保守性进行了基准测试。组屏蔽对数概率与 MSA 保守性适度相关(HA 的 Spearman rho = 0.25 至 0.39),但没有为 T 细胞表位辨别提供增量值(AUROC 的变化 +0.004,p = 0.46);注意力衍生的接触密度并不是有效的溶剂可及性代理。精心设计的抗体表位基准(22 个簇,5 个支持中和)对于高置信度 B 细胞测试来说动力不足。我们记录数据质量和可重复性缺陷(长度异质性、坐标映射和伪复制)并发布可审核的基准。这些结果提供了可审核的候选资源,并表明,在评估的基准中,ESM-2 序列评分并没有改善除比对衍生的保护之外的表位优先顺序。

title: Characterisation of a human monoclonal antibody targeting a conserved epitope at the base of the HA head of influenza A(H3N2) virus
abstract: BACKGROUND: Numerous broadly reactive human monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) against the haemagglutinin (HA) of influenza A viruses have recognised conserved epitopes across HA subtypes or within subtypes. Most heterosubtypic mAbs target the HA stem, the receptor-binding site (RBS), or the trimeric interface. Although at least three H3-specific mAbs recognise epitopes outside these regions, the overall landscape of conserved H3-specific epitopes remains incompletely understood. This study aimed to identify and characterise conserved epitopes on H3-HA to inform the development of vaccines resilient to antigenic change. METHODS: We screened a panel of previously reported H3-HA-reactive human mAbs to identify mAbs recognising conserved epitopes. The candidate clone, 034-10040 4F02 (4F02), was evaluated for neutralising, haemagglutination inhibiting, and HA-mediated fusion-inhibitory, Fc receptor-mediated effector functions in vitro, and for protective efficacy in a lethal mouse challenge model. Cryo-electron microscopy was used to define the structural basis of 4F02 binding. Human sera were screened for antibodies targeting similar epitopes. FINDINGS: Clone 4F02 recognised the HA of human influenza A (H3N2) viruses that circulated across multiple decades. It neutralised multiple H3N2 viruses, exhibited weak haemagglutination inhibition, blocked HA-mediated fusion activity, activated Fc receptor-mediated signalling, and protected mice against lethal challenge. Cryo-electron microscopy revealed that 4F02 targets the base of the HA head at a head-stem interface spanning antigenic sites C, D, and E. Antibodies targeting similar epitopes were detected, albeit at a low level, in human sera. INTERPRETATION: Characterisation of the 4F02 epitope reveals a previously underappreciated site of vulnerability at the H3-HA head-stem interface. This finding expands our understanding of conserved epitopes and provides a target for the development of influenza vaccines resilient to antigenic change. FUNDING: This work was supported by the Japan Agency for Medical Research and Development, JSPS KAKENHI, the National Institutes of Allergy and Infectious Diseases.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This finding provides a potential target for the development of influenza vaccines that are resilient to antigenic change, which could improve public health preparedness against seasonal influenza outbreaks.

analysis.summary_en: This study identifies and characterises a conserved epitope on the haemagglutinin (HA) protein of human influenza A(H3N2) viruses, revealing a previously underappreciated site of vulnerability at the HA head-stem interface. The monoclonal antibody 4F02 neutralises multiple H3N2 viruses, inhibits HA-mediated fusion, and provides protective efficacy in a mouse model. Cryo-electron microscopy defines the structural basis of 4F02 binding, and similar epitope-targeting antibodies are detected in human sera at low levels. These findings expand understanding of conserved epitopes and offer a potential target for vaccine development against antigenically changing influenza strains. The study's evidence is strong but limited to in vitro and animal models, which may affect generalisability to human populations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在识别并表征H3-HA上的保守表位,为开发能够抵御抗原变异的疫苗提供信息。多种广泛反应性人源单克隆抗体(mAb)已针对甲型流感病毒血凝素(HA)并识别出跨亚型或亚型内的保守表位。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究筛选了一组先前报道的针对H3-HA的反应性人源单克隆抗体,以识别能够识别保守表位的抗体。候选克隆4F02在体外被评估了中和活性、血凝抑制活性、HA介导的融合抑制活性以及Fc受体介导的效应功能,并在致死性小鼠攻击模型中评估了其保护效果。
elements_zh.methods: 我们筛选了一组先前报道的针对H3血凝素(HA)的反应性人单克隆抗体(mAb),以识别识别保守表位的mAb。使用冷冻电子显微镜确定了4F02结合的结构基础。筛选了人血清以检测针对类似表位的抗体。
elements_zh.main_results: 克隆 4F02 识别了传播数十年的人类甲型流感 (H3N2) 病毒的 HA。它能中和多种 H3N2 病毒,表现出微弱的血凝抑制作用,阻断 HA 介导的融合活性,激活 Fc 受体介导的信号传导,并保护小鼠免受致命攻击。冷冻电镜显示,4F02 靶向位于头-茎界面处的 HA 头基部,跨越抗原位点 C、D 和 E。在人类血清中检测到了针对类似表位的抗体,尽管水平较低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 对4F02表位的特征分析揭示了H3-HA头部茎部接口处一个此前未被充分重视的保守性位点。该发现拓展了对保守表位的认知,并为开发针对季节性流感的疫苗疫苗提供了靶标,该疫苗对抗原变异具有更强的适应性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这一发现为开发对抗原变化具有弹性的流感 疫苗 提供了一个潜在靶标,这可以改善针对 季节性流感 暴发 的公共卫生准备。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其依赖体外和小鼠模型数据而受到限制,这些数据可能无法完全代表人类 免疫应答。证据是强有力的,因为它通过功能验证直接识别和表征了 H3-HA 上的保守表位。

abstract_zh: 背景:多种广谱人源单克隆抗体(mAb)已针对甲型流感病毒血凝素(HA)的保守表位展开研究,这些表位可跨越不同HA亚型或在同一亚型内保守。大多数异亚型mAb靶向HA茎部、受体结合位点(RBS)或三聚体界面。尽管至少有三种H3特异性mAb识别这些区域外的表位,但H3-HA保守表位的整体格局仍未完全明确。本研究旨在识别并表征H3-HA上的保守表位,为开发能够抵御抗原变异的疫苗提供依据。方法:筛选既往报道的H3-HA反应性人源mAb,以识别识别保守表位的mAb。候选克隆034-10040 4F02(4F02)在体外接受中和活性、血凝抑制活性及HA介导的融合抑制活性和Fc受体介导的效应功能评估,并在致死性小鼠攻击模型中评估其保护效果。通过冷冻电子显微镜技术阐明4F02结合的结构基础。筛选人血清中针对类似表位的抗体。结果:克隆4F02识别跨越数十年流行的甲型H3N2流感病毒的HA。其可中和多种H3N2病毒,血凝抑制活性较弱,但可阻断HA介导的融合活性,激活Fc受体介导的信号传导,并在小鼠致死性攻击中提供保护。冷冻电子显微镜显示,4F02靶向HA头部基部的头-茎界面,该界面跨越抗原位点C、D和E。人血清中检测到针对类似表位的抗体,但水平较低。解读:对4F02表位的表征揭示了H3-HA头-茎界面这一先前被低估的脆弱位点。该发现拓展了对保守表位的认知,并为开发能够抵御抗原变异的流感疫苗提供了靶标。资助:本研究由日本医疗研究开发机构、JSPS KAKENHI及美国国立过敏症和传染病研究所资助。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在识别并表征H3-HA上的保守表位,为开发能够抵御抗原变异的疫苗提供信息。多种广泛反应性人源单克隆抗体(mAb)已针对甲型流感病毒血凝素(HA)并识别出跨亚型或亚型内的保守表位。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究筛选了一组先前报道的针对H3-HA的反应性人源单克隆抗体,以识别能够识别保守表位的抗体。候选克隆4F02在体外被评估了中和活性、血凝抑制活性、HA介导的融合抑制活性以及Fc受体介导的效应功能,并在致死性小鼠攻击模型中评估了其保护效果。
analysis_zh.methods: 我们筛选了一组先前报道的针对H3血凝素(HA)的反应性人单克隆抗体(mAb),以识别识别保守表位的mAb。使用冷冻电子显微镜确定了4F02结合的结构基础。筛选了人血清以检测针对类似表位的抗体。
analysis_zh.main_results: 克隆 4F02 识别了传播数十年的人类甲型流感 (H3N2) 病毒的 HA。它能中和多种 H3N2 病毒,表现出微弱的血凝抑制作用,阻断 HA 介导的融合活性,激活 Fc 受体介导的信号传导,并保护小鼠免受致命攻击。冷冻电镜显示,4F02 靶向位于头-茎界面处的 HA 头基部,跨越抗原位点 C、D 和 E。在人类血清中检测到了针对类似表位的抗体,尽管水平较低。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 对4F02表位的特征分析揭示了H3-HA头部茎部接口处一个此前未被充分重视的保守性位点。该发现拓展了对保守表位的认知,并为开发针对季节性流感的疫苗疫苗提供了靶标,该疫苗对抗原变异具有更强的适应性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这一发现为开发对抗原变化具有弹性的流感 疫苗 提供了一个潜在靶标,这可以改善针对 季节性流感 暴发 的公共卫生准备。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其依赖体外和小鼠模型数据而受到限制,这些数据可能无法完全代表人类 免疫应答。证据是强有力的,因为它通过功能验证直接识别和表征了 H3-HA 上的保守表位。

title: Severe co-infection with influenza A virus H3N2 and community-acquired methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus in a child presenting with septic shock, acute respiratory distress syndrome, and necrotizing pneumonia: a rare case report
abstract: Background Influenza co-infection with Staphylococcus aureus ( S. aureus ) can cause rapidly fatal necrotizing pneumonia, septic shock, and acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) in children. Although methicillin-resistant S. aureus is often highlighted, community-acquired methicillin-susceptible S. aureus (CA-MSSA) can also produce equally severe disease. Case presentation We report an 8-year-4-month-old male with influenza A (H3N2) who developed septic shock and refractory hypoxemia, requiring immediate intubation. Due to persisting respiratory failure despite maximal ventilation, veno-venous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO) was initiated on day 1. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing identified S. aureus as the dominant pathogen, and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid culture later confirmed MSSA. After vancomycin failed clinically, the regimen was switched to linezolid. However, on day 15 of linezolid therapy, the patient developed severe linezolid-induced lactic acidosis (LILA), which resolved within 3 days of stopping the drug. The clinical course was further complicated by pneumothorax and multidrug-resistant organism superinfections. After 54 days of intensive care, the patient was discharged in good condition. Conclusion This case underscores that during influenza seasons, early empirical anti-staphylococcal therapy should be considered in children with rapidly progressive pneumonia and shock, even when CA-MSSA is suspected. Additionally, routine lactate monitoring is critical during linezolid therapy to enable prompt recognition and management of life-threatening LILA.
journal: Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology

Case presentation We report an 8-year-4-month-old male with influenza A (H3N2) who developed septic shock and refractory hypoxemia, requiring immediate intubation. Due to persisting respiratory failure despite maximal ventilation, veno-venous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO) was initiated on day 1. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing identified S. aureus as the dominant pathogen, and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid culture later confirmed MSSA. After vancomycin failed clinically, the regimen was switched to linezolid. However, on day 15 of linezolid therapy, the patient developed severe linezolid-induced lactic acidosis (LILA), which resolved within 3 days of stopping the drug. The clinical course was further complicated by pneumothorax and multidrug-resistant organism superinfections. After 54 days of intensive care, the patient was discharged in good condition. Conclusion This case underscores that during influenza seasons, early empirical anti-staphylococcal therapy should be considered in children with rapidly progressive pneumonia and shock, even when CA-MSSA is suspected. Additionally, routine lactate monitoring is critical during linezolid therapy to enable prompt recognition and management of life-threatening LILA.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在强调儿童甲型流感病毒 H3N2 和社区获得性甲氧西林敏感金黄色葡萄球菌混合感染的潜在严重性,因为此类混合感染可导致迅速致命的坏死性肺炎、感染性休克和急性呼吸窘迫综合征 (ARDS)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究为一罕见病例报告,描述一名8岁4个月男童因感染甲型H3N2流感病毒与社区获得性耐甲氧西林敏感金黄色葡萄球菌重症合并感染,出现脓毒性休克及难治性低氧血症。患者需立即行气管插管,并接受利奈唑胺治疗,后因严重利奈唑胺诱导性乳酸性酸中毒而中断用药。
elements_zh.methods: 使用宏基因组下一代测序来鉴定主要病原体,支气管肺泡灌洗液培养证实存在甲氧西林敏感金黄色葡萄球菌。患者的临床病程通过抗葡萄球菌治疗进行管理,并监测乳酸性酸中毒等并发症。
elements_zh.main_results: 患者出现脓毒性休克及难治性低氧血症,需行气管插管并在第1天启动静脉-静脉体外膜肺氧合(VV-ECMO)。尽管接受利奈唑胺治疗,患者仍出现严重利奈唑胺诱导性乳酸性酸中毒,停药后症状缓解。患者最终于54天后康复出院。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,在流感季节,对于儿童快速进展性肺炎及休克患者,即使疑似社区获得性耐甲氧西林敏感金黄色葡萄球菌感染,也应考虑早期经验性抗葡萄球菌治疗。本病例强调识别并处理利奈唑胺治疗相关严重并发症的重要性。

title: ICU admission and mortality in adult patients with influenza A(H1N1)pdm09-related pneumonia in Vietnam since the 2009 H1N1 pandemic: A 10-year cohort study
abstract: Background The A(H1N1)pdm09 virus remains an important cause of severe influenza worldwide. This study examined the burden of ICU admission, mortality, and associated predictors among adults with A(H1N1)pdm09-related pneumonia treated at a leading infectious diseases hospital in Vietnam. Methods Demographic, clinical, laboratory, treatment, and outcome data were retrospectively collected from the medical records of adults hospitalized with laboratory-confirmed A(H1N1)pdm09 infection between 2009 and 2019. Results Among 729 patients with laboratory-confirmed A(H1N1)pdm09 infection, 21.7% (158/729) developed pneumonia. Among patients with pneumonia, 36.7% developed moderate-to-severe acute respiratory distress syndrome, 15.2% required invasive ventilation, 48.7% were admitted to the ICU, and 8.2% died. Independent predictors of ICU admission included age older than 60 years (AOR 18.91, 95% CI 3.60–99.24), the presence of comorbidities (AOR 9.39, 95% CI 2.75–32.06), and laboratory evidence of systemic inflammation, renal dysfunction, and hepatic involvement. Intensified antiviral therapy (AOR = 8.577, 95%CI 1.416–83.341, P = 0.020), and invasive ventilation (AOR 8.426, 95%CI 1.105–141.366, P = 0.039) were independently associated with mortality. Conclusions Mortality associated with A(H1N1)pdm09-related pneumonia remains substantial. Older patients, those with comorbidities, and those presenting with abnormal laboratory findings should be monitored closely for deterioration requiring intensive care. The study did not demonstrate improved outcomes with intensified antiviral regimens. Prospective studies are required before definitive treatment recommendations can be made.

title: Intranasal delivery of a COBRA-based protein vaccine adjuvanted with c-di-AMP enhances breadth of protective immune responses against seasonal influenza viruses
abstract: Seasonal influenza vaccines provide variable protection against antigenically drifted influenza A (H1N1 and H3N2) and influenza B viruses. Broadly protective approaches using computationally optimized broadly reactive antigens (COBRAs) can enhance immunity against diverse strains. Bis-(3′,5′)-cyclic dimeric adenosine monophosphate (c-di-AMP) is a mucosal adjuvant that boosts vaccine-induced immune responses. Here, we hypothesized that intranasal multivalent COBRA hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) vaccination with c-di-AMP would induce broad humoral and cellular immunity in mice. Immunologically naïve and pre-immune DBA/2J mice were intranasally immunized with pentavalent vaccine formulations containing COBRA recombinant HA and NA or corresponding wild-type antigens. Formulations were administered at low or high antigen doses, with or without the mucosal adjuvant c-di-AMP. Humoral and cellular immune responses were evaluated, along with protection following influenza A (H1N1 and H3N2) and influenza B viral challenge. Pentavalent COBRA HA/NA intranasal vaccination adjuvanted with c-di-AMP induced strong humoral and cellular immune responses in murine models. Vaccination induced robust, dose-dependent total IgG and hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) titers, along with high frequencies of antigen-specific antibody-secreting cells and interferon-γ (IFN-γ)-producing cells in pre-immune mice. Naïve mice were also seroprotected mainly against H1N1 at higher vaccine doses. Following lethal challenge with H1N1, H3N2, and influenza B viruses, vaccinated mice exhibited reduced weight loss, decreased lung viral titers, and enhanced survival, with the strongest protection observed in adjuvanted groups across both naïve and pre-immune models. These findings highlight the value of combining broadly protective COBRA vaccine candidates with advanced mucosal adjuvants to enhance efficacy against antigenically drifted influenza virus strains.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Seasonal influenza vaccines show variable protection against antigenically drifted influenza A (H1N1 and H3N2) and influenza B viruses, creating a need for broadly protective vaccine strategies. The study aimed to test whether intranasal multivalent COBRA hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) vaccination adjuvanted with c-di-AMP could induce broad humoral and cellular immunity in mice.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used immunologically naïve and pre-immune DBA/2J mice intranasally immunized with pentavalent vaccine formulations containing COBRA recombinant HA and NA or wild-type antigens. Formulations were administered at low or high antigen doses, with or without the mucosal adjuvant c-di-AMP.
analysis.methods: Humoral and cellular immune responses were evaluated, along with protection following influenza A (H1N1 and H3N2) and influenza B viral challenge. The study assessed total IgG and hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) titers, antigen-specific antibody-secreting cells, and interferon-γ (IFN-γ)-producing cells.
analysis.main_results: Following lethal challenge with H1N1, H3N2, and influenza B viruses, vaccinated mice exhibited reduced weight loss, decreased lung viral titers, and enhanced survival. The strongest protection was observed in adjuvanted groups across both naïve and pre-immune models.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that combining broadly protective COBRA vaccine candidates with the mucosal adjuvant c-di-AMP enhanced efficacy against antigenically drifted influenza virus strains. They highlighted the value of this approach for inducing broad humoral and cellular immunity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that intranasal COBRA-based protein vaccination with c-di-AMP could inform the development of next-generation influenza vaccines with broader protection against seasonal strains. The approach may address limitations of current vaccines in antigenically drifted settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in murine models, limiting direct translation to humans. While the evidence demonstrates robust immunogenicity and protection in mice, further research is needed to validate these findings in human clinical trials and assess long-term efficacy and safety.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated intranasal pentavalent COBRA hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) vaccination adjuvanted with c-di-AMP in mice to address the variable protection of seasonal influenza vaccines against drifted strains. Immunologically naïve and pre-immune DBA/2J mice received formulations at low or high doses with or without the mucosal adjuvant. Humoral and cellular immune responses were measured, including total IgG, HAI titers, antibody-secreting cells, and IFN-γ-producing cells. Following lethal challenge with H1N1, H3N2, and influenza B viruses, vaccinated mice showed reduced weight loss, lower lung viral titers, and improved survival, with the strongest protection in adjuvanted groups. The authors concluded that combining COBRA vaccines with c-di-AMP enhances breadth of immunity against antigenically drifted strains. These findings support the potential of intranasal COBRA-based protein vaccination with c-di-AMP to inform next-generation influenza vaccines, though murine model limitations necessitate human clinical validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 季节性流感 疫苗对抗原漂移的甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09、甲型H3N2流感病毒和乙型流感病毒的保护效果存在差异,亟需开发广泛保护性的疫苗策略。本研究旨在验证鼻内多价COBRA血凝素(HA)和神经氨酸酶(NA)疫苗接种(含c-di-AMP佐剂)是否能在小鼠体内诱导广泛的体液和细胞免疫应答。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用免疫原性未知及预免疫的DBA/2J小鼠,通过鼻内接种含COBRA重组HA和NA或野生型抗原的五价疫苗制剂。制剂以低剂量或高剂量抗原给药,并添加或不添加黏膜佐剂c-di-AMP。
elements_zh.methods: 评估了体液和细胞免疫应答,以及甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09、甲型H3N2流感病毒和乙型流感病毒攻击后的保护效果。研究测定了总IgG和血凝抑制(HAI)滴度、抗原特异性抗体分泌细胞以及干扰素-γ(IFN-γ)分泌细胞。
elements_zh.main_results: 在致死剂量攻击甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09、甲型H3N2流感病毒和乙型流感病毒后,接种疫苗的小鼠表现出体重减轻减少、肺部病毒滴度降低和存活率提高。在含佐剂组中观察到最强的保护效果,且在免疫原性未知及预免疫模型中均成立。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,将具有广泛保护性的 COBRA 疫苗 候选药物与粘膜佐剂 c-di-AMP 相结合,可增强针对抗原漂移流感病毒株的功效。他们强调了这种方法对于诱导广泛的体液和细胞免疫的价值。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,鼻内给药含c-di-AMP佐剂的COBRA基蛋白疫苗接种有望为开发针对季节性流感株提供更广泛保护的下一代流感疫苗提供依据。该方法或可解决现有疫苗在抗原漂移情境下的局限性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究在小鼠模型中进行,限制了结果向人类的直接外推。尽管证据在小鼠中显示出强效免疫原性和保护作用,仍需进一步在人体临床试验中验证这些发现,并评估其长期有效性和安全性。

title_zh: 鼻内给药含c-di-AMP佐剂的COBRA基蛋白疫苗可增强对季节性流感病毒的广泛保护作用
source_body_en: Seasonal influenza vaccines provide variable protection against antigenically drifted influenza A (H1N1 and H3N2) and influenza B viruses. Broadly protective approaches using computationally optimized broadly reactive antigens (COBRAs) can enhance immunity against diverse strains. Bis-(3′,5′)-cyclic dimeric adenosine monophosphate (c-di-AMP) is a mucosal adjuvant that boosts vaccine-induced immune responses. Here, we hypothesized that intranasal multivalent COBRA hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) vaccination with c-di-AMP would induce broad humoral and cellular immunity in mice. Immunologically naïve and pre-immune DBA/2J mice were intranasally immunized with pentavalent vaccine formulations containing COBRA recombinant HA and NA or corresponding wild-type antigens. Formulations were administered at low or high antigen doses, with or without the mucosal adjuvant c-di-AMP. Humoral and cellular immune responses were evaluated, along with protection following influenza A (H1N1 and H3N2) and influenza B viral challenge. Pentavalent COBRA HA/NA intranasal vaccination adjuvanted with c-di-AMP induced strong humoral and cellular immune responses in murine models. Vaccination induced robust, dose-dependent total IgG and hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) titers, along with high frequencies of antigen-specific antibody-secreting cells and interferon-γ (IFN-γ)-producing cells in pre-immune mice. Naïve mice were also seroprotected mainly against H1N1 at higher vaccine doses. Following lethal challenge with H1N1, H3N2, and influenza B viruses, vaccinated mice exhibited reduced weight loss, decreased lung viral titers, and enhanced survival, with the strongest protection observed in adjuvanted groups across both naïve and pre-immune models. These findings highlight the value of combining broadly protective COBRA vaccine candidates with advanced mucosal adjuvants to enhance efficacy against antigenically drifted influenza virus strains.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 季节性流感 疫苗对抗原漂移的甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09、甲型H3N2流感病毒和乙型流感病毒的保护效果存在差异,亟需开发广泛保护性的疫苗策略。本研究旨在验证鼻内多价COBRA血凝素(HA)和神经氨酸酶(NA)疫苗接种(含c-di-AMP佐剂)是否能在小鼠体内诱导广泛的体液和细胞免疫应答。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用免疫原性未知及预免疫的DBA/2J小鼠,通过鼻内接种含COBRA重组HA和NA或野生型抗原的五价疫苗制剂。制剂以低剂量或高剂量抗原给药,并添加或不添加黏膜佐剂c-di-AMP。
analysis_zh.methods: 评估了体液和细胞免疫应答,以及甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09、甲型H3N2流感病毒和乙型流感病毒攻击后的保护效果。研究测定了总IgG和血凝抑制(HAI)滴度、抗原特异性抗体分泌细胞以及干扰素-γ(IFN-γ)分泌细胞。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在致死剂量攻击甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09、甲型H3N2流感病毒和乙型流感病毒后,接种疫苗的小鼠表现出体重减轻减少、肺部病毒滴度降低和存活率提高。在含佐剂组中观察到最强的保护效果,且在免疫原性未知及预免疫模型中均成立。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,将具有广泛保护性的 COBRA 疫苗 候选药物与粘膜佐剂 c-di-AMP 相结合,可增强针对抗原漂移流感病毒株的功效。他们强调了这种方法对于诱导广泛的体液和细胞免疫的价值。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,鼻内给药含c-di-AMP佐剂的COBRA基蛋白疫苗接种有望为开发针对季节性流感株提供更广泛保护的下一代流感疫苗提供依据。该方法或可解决现有疫苗在抗原漂移情境下的局限性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究在小鼠模型中进行,限制了结果向人类的直接外推。尽管证据在小鼠中显示出强效免疫原性和保护作用,仍需进一步在人体临床试验中验证这些发现,并评估其长期有效性和安全性。

As atmospheric viral concentrations are very low, a sampler with a high viral collection efficiency is essential. Although multiple approaches for evaluating collection efficiency have been applied using various samplers, no standardized sampler has yet been developed. analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to clarify the collection efficiency of the wet-type electrostatic precipitator (WT-ESP) for airborne viruses, as atmospheric viral concentrations are very low and a reliable sampler is essential for public health surveillance.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated the collection efficiency of the WT-ESP using two approaches: direct spray, where virus-containing aerosols were sprayed directly into the WT-ESP inlet, and indirect spray, where aerosols were dispersed into a closed space and then collected using the sampler.
analysis.methods: The study used direct spray and indirect spray methods to assess the collection efficiency of the WT-ESP, with the latter involving aerosol dispersion into a closed space before sampling.
analysis.main_results: The direct spray tests achieved 20.1–50.2% collection efficiency, whereas the indirect spray test achieved an efficiency of 32.8–48.5%.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that the WT-ESP can effectively collect airborne influenza A virus, providing a potential tool for improving viral surveillance in public health settings.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that the WT-ESP could enhance the detection of airborne influenza viruses, supporting more accurate public health monitoring and response strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-only evidence, and the efficiency values are based on controlled experimental conditions, which may not fully reflect real-world scenarios.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the collection efficiency of a wet-type electrostatic precipitator (WT-ESP) for aerosolized influenza A virus using direct and indirect spray methods. The direct spray tests achieved 20.1–50.2% efficiency, while the indirect spray tests showed 32.8–48.5% efficiency. These results suggest that the WT-ESP could be a useful tool for improving viral surveillance in public health settings. title: Dose-Dependent Alterations in Lung Immune Subpopulations in Influenza a Virus Infection
abstract: This study aimed to characterize the modulation in immune cell subpopulations in murine lungs following influenza A virus (IAV) infection, assessing the effects of infectious dose, viral adaptation, and NS1 expression. Immune cell subsets were profiled by surface receptor expression using multiparametric flow cytometry with a 10-antibody immunophenotyping panel. Neutrophils expressing Ly-6G were significantly increased in the lungs following lethal-dose infection with IAV, independently of NS1 expression; in contrast, lethal-dose infection with all viruses reduced CD163+ and F4/80+ neutrophil subpopulations. Lethal-dose infection increased pulmonary CD68+ macrophages while decreasing CD163+, CD193+, and F4/80+ macrophage subsets, as well as F4/80+ myeloid cells, by day 3 post-infection; these reductions were independent of NS1 expression and infectious dose. Following lethal-dose IAV infection, NK cells exhibited upregulation of IL-23R+ and IL-12Rβ2+ subsets, while the CD193+ NK subpopulation was decreased on day 3 post-infection. Profiling of NKT cells revealed an expansion of the IL-12Rβ2+ NKT subset on day 3 post-infection. Adaptive immune profiling of lung CD4+ T cells revealed a selective increase in Th1-like cells (IL-12Rβ2+ CD4+) after WSN infection, a marked reduction in Th2-like cells (CD193+ CD4+) following infection with IAV regardless of NS1 status or dose, and an expansion of CD4+NK1.1+ cells only after lethal-dose infection. Immune cell subset frequencies were comparable between infections with NS1-expressing and wild-type viruses; NS1 expression did not alter subset composition, whereas the infection dose modulated their abundance. These findings expand our understanding of the subpopulation of immune cells and their possible role in influenza virus pathogenesis.

Using multiparametric flow cytometry, the researchers observed that lethal-dose IAV infection significantly increased Ly-6G+ neutrophils while reducing CD163+ and F4/80+ neutrophil subpopulations. Additionally, lethal-dose infection led to an increase in CD68+ macrophages and a decrease in CD163+, CD193+, and F4/80+ macrophage subsets, as well as F4/80+ myeloid cells, by day 3 post-infection. NK cells showed upregulation of IL-23R+ and IL-12Rβ2+ subsets, while the CD193+ NK subpopulation was decreased. NKT cell profiling revealed an expansion of the IL-12Rβ2+ subset. These findings provide insights into the immune response to IAV and its potential role in pathogenesis. The study's results are limited by the use of murine models and the focus on specific immune subpopulations, which may not fully translate to human influenza pathogenesis.

source_body_en: This study aimed to characterize the modulation in immune cell subpopulations in murine lungs following influenza A virus (IAV) infection, assessing the effects of infectious dose, viral adaptation, and NS1 expression. Immune cell subsets were profiled by surface receptor expression using multiparametric flow cytometry with a 10-antibody immunophenotyping panel. Neutrophils expressing Ly-6G were significantly increased in the lungs following lethal-dose infection with IAV, independently of NS1 expression; in contrast, lethal-dose infection with all viruses reduced CD163+ and F4/80+ neutrophil subpopulations. Following lethal-dose IAV infection, NK cells exhibited upregulation of IL-23R+ and IL-12Rβ2+ subsets, while the CD193+ NK subpopulation was decreased on day 3 post-infection. Profiling of NKT cells revealed an expansion of the IL-12Rβ2+ NKT subset on day 3 post-infection. Adaptive immune profiling of lung CD4+ T cells revealed a selective increase in Th1-like cells (IL-12Rβ2+ CD4+) after WSN infection, a marked reduction in Th2-like cells (CD193+ CD4+) following infection with IAV regardless of NS1 status or dose, and an expansion of CD4+NK1.1+ cells only after lethal-dose infection. Immune cell subset frequencies were comparable between infections with NS1-expressing and wild-type viruses; NS1 expression did not alter subset composition, whereas the infection dose modulated their abundance. These findings expand our understanding of the subpopulation of immune cells and their possible role in influenza virus pathogenesis.

title: Influenza A virus initiates genome selection through promoter-dependent nuclear export
abstract: Abstract Influenza A virus replicates its segmented RNA genome in the nucleus in the context of viral ribonucleoprotein (vRNP) complexes. Newly synthesised vRNPs are exported to the cytoplasm for virion assembly, whereas structurally similar complementary RNPs (cRNPs), which function as replication intermediates, are not incorporated into virions. The molecular basis for this selectivity remains unclear. Here, combining promoter mutagenesis, single-molecule fluorescence in situ hybridisation (smFISH), virus-like particle (VLP) assays and cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM), we find that cRNPs are retained in the nucleus and that export competence is encoded by promoter architecture, with the length of the single-stranded 3′ promoter region as the principal contributing feature and promoter sequence and duplex architecture further modulating export efficiency. cRNPs carrying export-competent promoters are incorporated into virus-like particles, demonstrating a functional link between nuclear export and packaging competence. Cryo-EM analyses reveal that both 3′ vRNA and cRNA promoters bind a common polymerase surface site but are associated with distinct polymerase conformational landscapes, with only the vRNA promoter being compatible with an encapsidase conformation of the polymerase. Together, our findings identify a promoter-dependent checkpoint that links RNA promoter architecture and polymerase conformation to RNP export and packaging. These results demonstrate that influenza virus initiates genome selection in the nucleus and reveal nuclear export as an early step in genome selection.

abstract_zh: 摘要 甲型流感病毒在病毒核糖核蛋白(vRNP)复合体环境下于细胞核内复制其分节段RNA 基因组。新合成的vRNP被输出至细胞质以进行病毒颗粒组装,而结构相似的互补RNP(cRNP,作为复制中间体)则不会被包装入病毒颗粒。这一选择性的分子基础仍不清楚。本研究结合启动子突变、单分子荧光原位杂交(smFISH)、病毒样颗粒(VLP)检测及冷冻电子显微镜(cryo-EM)技术,发现cRNP被滞留于细胞核内,且其输出能力由启动子结构编码,其中单链3′启动子区域的长度是主要贡献因素,而启动子序列与双链结构进一步调控输出效率。携带输出能力启动子的cRNP可被包装入病毒样颗粒,证明核输出与包装能力之间存在功能关联。冷冻电子显微镜分析显示,3′ vRNA与cRNA启动子均可结合聚合酶的同一表面位点,但与不同的聚合酶构象景观相关,仅vRNA启动子与聚合酶的包装酶构象相兼容。综上,本研究识别出一个启动子依赖性检查点,将RNA启动子结构与聚合酶构象与RNP输出及包装联系起来。这些结果表明甲型流感病毒在细胞核内启动基因组选择,并揭示核输出是基因组选择的早期步骤。

title: Comparison of the adjuvant effect of AS01, AS03 and alum on the immune response to GMP-grade H5N1 antigen in guinea pigs
abstract: Adjuvants function as an enhancer and activator of the immune response and can be of pivotal importance for the efficacy of vaccines. AS01, which is a liposome formulation spiked with the saponin derivate QS-21 and the detoxified lipopolysaccharide MPL-A, and AS03, which is a squalene-based oil in water emulsion that contains antioxidant tocopherol, are modern, highly potent adjuvants that became integral to innovative vaccines. In the current study, guinea pigs -a well-established small animal model for human influenza-infections- were subcutaneously vaccinated with an influenza H5N1-antigen formulated with AS01, AS03, aluminium hydroxide or left unformulated. The induction of T- and B cells specific for the influenza antigen was assessed in dependence of the antigen formulation. H5N1-specific T cell responses were observed with all adjuvant formulations, but after six months were highest in the AS01- and AS03-immunized groups. The influenza specific antibody titres were highest in AS03-vaccinated guinea pigs. Importantly, AS03- and AS01-formulated influenza antigen also induced crossreactive antibodies inhibiting related H5N3- but not a distant H5N8-influenza strain. At the same time, it was observed that animals, which received the egg-produced H5N1 split antigen in combination with AS03, mounted xenoreactive, opsonizing antibodies that bound to chicken fibroblasts. No reactivity was observed to human fibroblasts. In summary, our results confirm the superior adjuvanticity of AS03 and of AS01 as compared to conventional alum or non-adjuvanted formulations. The presence of xenoreactive antibodies after AS03 vaccination was an unexpected observation. Further investigations will be required to appreciate the significance and identify the mechanisms of this findings.

abstract_zh: 佐剂作为免疫应答的增强剂和激活剂,对疫苗的效力具有至关重要的作用。AS01是一种含有皂苷衍生物QS-21和脱毒脂多糖MPL-A的脂质体制剂,而AS03则是一种含有抗氧化剂生育酚的角鲨烯基油水乳剂,这两种佐剂均为现代高效佐剂,已成为创新型疫苗的重要组成部分。在本研究中,豚鼠(一种用于人类流感感染的经典小动物模型)通过皮下接种含有AS01、AS03、氢氧化铝或未经佐剂处理的H5N1流感抗原进行免疫。随后评估了不同佐剂处理下针对流感抗原的T细胞和B细胞的诱导情况。所有佐剂处理组均观察到针对H5N1的T细胞应答,但在6个月后,AS01和AS03免疫组的应答水平最高。流感特异性抗体滴度在AS03免疫豚鼠中最高。值得注意的是,AS03和AS01佐剂处理的流感抗原还诱导了可交叉反应的抗体,可抑制相关H5N3流感毒株(但不包括远缘H5N8流感毒株)。同时,接受卵生产的H5N1裂解抗原与AS03组合的动物产生了针对鸡成纤维细胞的异喀性、调理作用抗体。未观察到对人成纤维细胞的反应性。综上所述,本研究结果证实了AS03和AS01相较于传统明矾或无佐剂处理的佐剂效应更为优越。AS03佐剂处理后出现异喀性抗体是一个意外发现。未来需进一步研究以评估该发现的意义并阐明其机制。

title: Bacterial co-infection and antimicrobial use in hospital-attended patients with laboratory-confirmed influenza infection: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
abstract: BackgroundBacterial co-infection contributes substantially to influenza-associated morbidity and mortality. Patterns of viral circulation, diagnostic testing and antimicrobial use changed markedly during the COVID-19 pandemic, yet contemporary estimates of bacterial co-infection and antimicrobial use in influenza have not been synthesised. ObjectivesTo estimate the pooled prevalence of microbiologically confirmed bacterial co-infection among hospital-attended patients with laboratory-confirmed influenza. Secondary objectives were to characterise co-infecting bacterial pathogens, quantify antimicrobial prescribing overall and across key subgroups. This study was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251072782). Data sources and eligibilityWe searched Embase (Ovid), MEDLINE, PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science to 15th June 2025 for studies including [≥]50 hospital-attended patients with laboratory-confirmed influenza and reporting bacterial co-infection. MethodsPooled prevalence estimates and antimicrobial prescription proportions were calculated using a generalised linear mixed model with logit link. Subgroup analyses included age group, clinical setting, and seasonal vs. Risk of bias was assessed using JBI Critical Appraisal tools and certainty of evidence using GRADE. ResultsNinety-seven studies from 30 countries, comprising 116,273 patients with influenza, met inclusion criteria; 10,880 had confirmed bacterial co-infection. The pooled prevalence was 16.7% (95%CI 13.9-20.0%; I2=99.0%). Prevalence was higher in ICU compared to non-ICU settings (27.6% vs. The most frequently identified bacterial pathogens were Streptococcus pneumoniae (35.7%) and Staphylococcus aureus (30.3%). Antimicrobial use, reported in 38 studies, was high (pooled prevalence 88.1%, 95%CI 76.0-94.5%; I2=99.9%), and was more common in adults than children (97.8% vs 65.0%), and in ICU compared with non-ICU settings (96% vs 81%). ConclusionsBacterial co-infection was identified in approximately one in six hospital-attended influenza cases, yet antimicrobial prescribing is near-universal. Substantial heterogeneity and diagnostic variability constraint interpretation but underscore persistent challenges in clinical decision-making. These findings support strengthened diagnostic capacity and antimicrobial stewardship to optimise management of suspected influenza-associated bacterial co-infection.

analysis.scope_and_question: The study aimed to estimate the pooled prevalence of microbiologically confirmed bacterial co-infection among hospital-attended patients with laboratory-confirmed influenza, and to characterise co-infecting bacterial pathogens and quantify antimicrobial prescribing overall and across key subgroups.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review was conducted using a systematic approach, searching Embase (Ovid), MEDLINE, PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science up to 15th June 2025. Studies were included if they had ≥50 hospital-attended patients with laboratory-confirmed influenza and reported bacterial co-infection. Pooled prevalence estimates and antimicrobial prescription proportions were calculated using a generalised linear mixed model with logit link. analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled prevalence of bacterial co-infection among hospital-attended patients with laboratory-confirmed influenza was 16.7% (95%CI 13.9-20.0%; I2=99.0%). The most frequently identified bacterial pathogens were Streptococcus pneumoniae (35.7%) and Staphylococcus aureus (30.3%). analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to estimate the prevalence of bacterial co-infection and antimicrobial use in hospital-attended patients with laboratory-confirmed influenza. The study included 97 studies from 30 countries, involving 116,273 patients, of whom 10,880 had confirmed bacterial co-infection. The pooled prevalence of bacterial co-infection was 16.7% (95%CI 13.9-20.0%), with Streptococcus pneumoniae and Staphylococcus aureus being the most common pathogens. Antimicrobial use was high (88.1%, 95%CI 76.0-94.5%), more common in adults and ICU settings. The review highlights substantial heterogeneity and diagnostic variability, which limit interpretation and underscore the need for improved diagnostic tools and antimicrobial stewardship to manage influenza-associated bacterial co-infection effectively.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述采用系统方法进行,检索了Embase(Ovid)、MEDLINE、PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science,截止至2025年6月15日。纳入标准为包含≥50名医院就诊且实验室确诊流感的患者,并报告了细菌共感染的研究。使用广义线性混合模型(logit链接)计算汇总患病率估计值和抗菌药物处方比例。使用JBI批判性评价工具评估偏倚风险,并使用GRADE评估证据的确定性。

title: Influenza A deletion-containing viral genome production is altered by metabolites, metabolic signaling molecules, and cyanobacterial extracts
abstract: ABSTRACT RNA virus infections generate abundant non-standard viral genomes that have been associated with milder clinical outcomes, leading to research into harnessing them as novel antivirals. We recently showed that altering host cell metabolism away from pro-growth pathways using alpelisib increased the production of influenza A nonstandard viral genomes (specifically deletion-containing viral genomes, DelVGs). To uncover more drugs that could induce increased DelVGs, we subjected influenza infections (A/H1N1 and A/H3N2) to a screen of metabolites, metabolic signaling molecules, and cyanobacterium-derived biologics, and quantified DelVGs and total viral genomes using long-read sequencing. We show that metabolites and signaling molecules of host cell central carbon metabolism can significantly alter DelVG production early in influenza A infection. Adenosine emerged as a potent inducer of defective viral genomes, significantly amplifying DelVG production across both subtypes. Insulin had similar effects, albeit subtype-specific, predominantly enhancing polymerase segment DelVGs in A/H3N2 infections. Tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle inhibitors, 4-octyl itaconate and UK5099, along with the purine analog favipiravir, increased total viral genome production across subtypes. Cyanobacterial extracts primarily affected DelVGs and total viral genome production in A/H3N2 infections, with a specific, almost complete shutdown of influenza antigenic segments. These results suggest new avenues for antiviral intervention, including host metabolic pathways (PI3K-AKT, Ras-MAPK pathways, TCA, and purine-pyrimidine) and cyanotherapeutics that affect DelVG production. Our study advances our fundamental understanding of DelVG production mechanisms and highlights the potential of targeting host metabolism to develop broad-spectrum influenza therapeutics. IMPORTANCE Antivirals currently available for flu infections lack effectiveness or face rapid emergence of antiviral resistance. Flu infections naturally produce nonstandard viral genomes, which interfere with viral reproduction and lead to milder clinical outcomes. Here, we test drugs that alter the host metabolism to induce influenza infections to produce more of this “natural antiviral.” We find that molecules generated from human metabolism, particularly adenosine, can increase these deletion-containing viral genomes (DelVGs) and also find evidence that biological extracts from cyanobacteria have antiviral effects. Our findings suggest that the social interactions observed between defective and full-length viral genomes depend not only on the viral actors but can also be altered by the stage provided by the host. Our findings have potential applications to increasing DelVG production for research or industrial uses; employing metabolites as biomarkers for flu infection severity; and using drugs to alter host metabolism to steer influenza infections to milder outcomes.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore how altering host cell metabolism could influence the production of nonstandard viral genomes in influenza infections, as these genomes have been linked to milder clinical outcomes. The research was driven by the need for new antiviral strategies, given the limitations of current flu treatments.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved screening influenza infections (A/H1N1 and A/H3N2) for metabolites, metabolic signaling molecules, and cyanobacterial extracts to identify agents that could increase the production of deletion-containing viral genomes (DelVGs). The research was conducted using long-read sequencing to quantify DelVGs and total viral genomes.
analysis.methods: The researchers performed a screen of metabolites, metabolic signaling molecules, and cyanobacterial extracts on influenza infections (A/H1N1 and A/H3N2). They quantified DelVGs and total viral genomes using long-read sequencing to assess the impact of these agents on viral genome production.
analysis.main_results: Metabolites and signaling molecules from host central carbon metabolism significantly altered DelVG production early in influenza A infection. Adenosine was identified as a potent inducer of DelVGs, increasing their production across both subtypes. TCA cycle inhibitors and the purine analog favipiravir increased total viral genome production across subtypes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that host metabolic pathways, such as the PI3K-AKT and Ras-MAPK pathways, can be targeted to increase DelVG production, offering new antiviral strategies. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the mechanisms of DelVG production and suggest that targeting host metabolism could lead to the development of broad-spectrum influenza therapeutics, potentially steering infections toward milder outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how altering host cell metabolism can influence the production of nonstandard viral genomes, specifically deletion-containing viral genomes (DelVGs), in influenza A infections. The research highlights that metabolites and signaling molecules from central carbon metabolism can significantly impact DelVG production early in infection. Adenosine was found to be a potent inducer of DelVGs across both A/H1N1 and A/H3N2 subtypes, while TCA cycle inhibitors and favipiravir increased total viral genome production. The findings suggest that targeting host metabolic pathways could offer new antiviral strategies, potentially leading to milder clinical outcomes. However, the study is based on abstract-level evidence and relies on in vitro or in vivo models, limiting its clinical applicability. The results contribute to understanding DelVG production mechanisms and highlight the potential of metabolites and cyanobacterial extracts in antiviral interventions.

abstract_zh: 摘要 RNA病毒感染会产生大量非标准病毒基因组,这些病毒与较轻的临床结果相关,因此引发了研究利用它们作为新型抗病毒药物的探索。我们最近发现,使用阿来匹利(alpelisib)改变宿主细胞代谢,使其偏离促生长通路,可以显著增加流感A型非标准病毒基因组(特别是含有缺失的病毒基因组,DelVGs)的生成。为了发现更多能够诱导DelVGs生成的药物,我们对流感感染(A/H1N1和A/H3N2)进行了代谢物、代谢信号分子和蓝藻衍生生物制剂的筛选,并使用长读长测序技术量化了DelVGs和总病毒基因组。我们发现,宿主细胞中心碳代谢产生的代谢物和信号分子可以显著改变流感A型感染早期DelVGs的生成。腺苷被鉴定为一种强效的缺陷病毒基因组诱导剂,能够显著增强两种亚型的DelVGs生成。胰岛素也有类似效果,但具有亚型特异性,主要增强A/H3N2感染中聚合酶片段的DelVGs生成。三羧酸(TCA)循环抑制剂4-辛基衣康酸和UK5099,以及嘌呤类似物 Favipiravir,能够增强两种亚型的总病毒基因组生成。蓝藻提取物主要影响A/H3N2感染中DelVGs和总病毒基因组的生成,特别是几乎完全抑制了流感抗原片段的生成。这些结果表明,针对宿主代谢通路(PI3K-AKT、Ras-MAPK通路、TCA和嘌呤-嘧啶通路)以及影响DelVGs生成的蓝藻治疗药物,可能为抗病毒药物干预提供新的途径。我们的研究加深了对DelVGs生成机制的基本理解,并突出了通过靶向宿主代谢来开发广谱流感治疗药物的潜力。重要性 目前用于流感感染的抗病毒药物缺乏有效性或面临快速出现的抗病毒药物耐药性问题。流感感染自然会产生非标准病毒基因组,这些病毒干扰病毒繁殖并导致较轻的临床结果。在这里,我们测试了能够改变宿主代谢的药物,以诱导流感感染产生更多的这种“天然抗病毒药物”。我们发现,由人类代谢产生的分子,特别是腺苷,可以增加这些含有缺失的病毒基因组(DelVGs)的生成,并且还发现蓝藻提取物具有抗病毒药物效应。我们的发现表明,观察到的缺陷病毒和全长病毒基因组之间的社会互动不仅取决于病毒本身,还可能受到宿主提供的阶段的影响。我们的发现可能在增加DelVGs生成用于研究或工业用途、利用代谢物作为流感感染严重程度的生物标志物以及使用药物改变宿主代谢以引导流感感染向较轻结果发展方面具有潜在应用价值。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨如何通过改变宿主细胞代谢来影响流感感染中非标准病毒基因组的生成,因为这些基因组已被与较轻的临床结果相关联。研究的动机源于当前流感治疗策略的局限性,需要新的抗病毒药物方法。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究对流感感染(A/H1N1和A/H3N2)进行了代谢物、代谢信号分子和蓝藻提取物的筛选,以识别能够增加含有缺失的病毒基因组(DelVGs)生成的物质。研究使用长读长测序技术来量化DelVGs和总病毒基因组。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员对流感感染(A/H1N1和A/H3N2)进行了代谢物、代谢信号分子和蓝藻提取物的筛选。他们使用长读长测序技术量化DelVGs和总病毒基因组,以评估这些物质对病毒基因组生成的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 宿主细胞中心碳代谢产生的代谢物和信号分子在流感A型感染早期显著改变了DelVGs的生成。腺苷被鉴定为一种强效的DelVGs诱导剂,能够增强两种亚型的DelVGs生成。TCA循环抑制剂和嘌呤类似物Favipiravir能够增强两种亚型的总病毒基因组生成。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,宿主代谢通路,如PI3K-AKT和Ras-MAPK通路,可以作为靶点以增加DelVGs的生成,从而提供新的抗病毒药物策略。本研究突出了利用代谢物和蓝藻提取物来影响病毒基因组生成的潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果揭示了DelVGs生成的机制,并表明靶向宿主代谢可能有助于开发广谱流感治疗药物,从而将感染引导至较轻的临床结果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于抽象层面的证据,其发现基于体外或体内模型,而非临床数据。证据强度中等,因为结果来源于筛选方法,缺乏详细的机制或临床验证。

title: Rational design of M2e-based nanoparticle vaccines for universal influenza a protection
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Influenza A virus poses ongoing global health and economic challenges due to its antigenic variability and pandemic potential. Current seasonal vaccines targeting the variable hemagglutinin (HA) provide limited and strain-specific protection. The conserved Matrix 2 Ectodomain (M2e) offers a promising universal vaccine target, eliciting protection by targeting infected cells rather than neutralizing virions. However, the mechanism underlying protection mediated by this simple antigen is complex, and no M2e-based vaccine has been licensed yet. AREA COVERED: Precise M2e-vaccine optimization is needed. This review provides in-depth description of M2e established knowledge, as well as comparative studies using M2e-based vaccines. From this, the 'ideal archetype' of a universal vaccine including M2e will be defined. Finally, a review of the current preclinical nanoparticle based M2e vaccine will be provided, described, and analyzed. EXPERT OPINION: Optimizing antigen presentation, evaluating Fc-mediated effector functions with standardized assays, and integrating M2e into multivalent nanoparticle platforms targeting complementary conserved antigens are likely to be key steps toward achieving broad, durable, and clinically translatable protection.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on the development of M2e-based nanoparticle vaccines for universal influenza A protection. It highlights the challenges posed by the antigenic variability of seasonal influenza A viruses and the limitations of current HA-targeting vaccines. The conserved M2e antigen is presented as a promising target for universal vaccines, as it elicits protection by targeting infected cells rather than neutralizing virions. However, the mechanism of M2e-mediated protection remains complex, and no licensed M2e-based vaccine exists. These steps are emphasized as critical for achieving broad, durable, and clinically relevant protection against influenza A viruses.

title: Knowledge, attitudes and perceptions about influenza vaccination among pregnant women in Kuwait: a descriptive cross-sectional study
abstract: Abstract Maternal influenza vaccination (MIV) is the most effective measure of preventing severe influenza-related complications in pregnant women. However, there is limited knowledge about MIV uptake in Kuwait. This study aimed to assess pregnant women’s knowledge, attitudes, and perceptions regarding MIV uptake and provision in Kuwait. A cross-sectional, hospital-based study using a self-administered electronic questionnaire adapted from the World Health Organization (WHO) Tailoring Immunization Programmes (TIP FLU) questionnaire was conducted among 272 pregnant and recently delivered women attending governmental maternity hospitals and antenatal clinics in Kuwait between October 2022 and January 2023. analysis.study_design_and_population: A descriptive, cross-sectional, hospital-based study was conducted among 272 pregnant and recently delivered women attending governmental maternity hospitals and antenatal clinics in Kuwait between October 2022 and January 2023 using a self-administered electronic questionnaire adapted from the WHO Tailoring Immunization Programmes (TIP FLU) tool.
analysis.methods: The study used a self-administered electronic questionnaire adapted from the WHO TIP FLU tool to assess knowledge, attitudes, and perceptions about MIV among participants. Data were collected from governmental maternity hospitals and antenatal clinics during the specified period.
analysis.main_results: Only 22 participants (8.1%) reported receiving MIV during their current or most recent pregnancy. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the low MIV uptake and knowledge as indicating missed opportunities for antenatal education and provider recommendation. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeted antenatal education and routine healthcare provider recommendations could improve MIV uptake in Kuwait, potentially reducing influenza-related morbidity in pregnant women.
